title: Why both Haas drivers are getting Monza aero upgrades – but only Ollie Bearman has a new PU
paragraphs: The Italian Grand Prix is a big weekend for Haas as the team brings its first major upgrade package since Canada back in May. The VF-26 has slipped towards the tail of the midfield pack in recent races, having been jumped by Aston Martin ’s AMR26. There’s also been a rollercoaster of form between Ollie Bearman and Esteban Ocon , with typically one struggling and the other a lot happier on a given
